story.overview:
P0 bug fix for Story 8.2 implementation gap. The `tool_search_tool_bm25` built-in tool must be explicitly added to the tools array when deferred tools exist. Without it, Claude cannot discover MCP tools that have `defer_loading: true`, causing all deferred MCP tools to be invisible.
**Root Cause:** The SDK documentation shows `tool_search_tool_bm25_20251119` is a required built-in tool that must be explicitly added - it is NOT automatically provided by the API when deferred tools exist.
**Impact:** Blocks all MCP tool usage when Tool Search is enabled (default: `TOOL_SEARCH_ENABLED=true`).
story.user-story: As a **platform operator**, I want the `tool_search_tool_bm25` built-in tool to be explicitly added to the tools array when deferred tools exist, So that Claude can discover and use MCP tools that have `defer_loading: true` enabled.

acceptance-criteria.criterion: **Given** tool search is enabled AND deferred tools exist, **When** the agent loop builds the tools array, **Then** `tool_search_tool_bm25` is included with correct type and name
**Given** tool search is disabled OR no deferred tools exist, **When** the agent loop builds the tools array, **Then** `tool_search_tool_bm25` is NOT included (no unnecessary tool)
**Given** a model that does not support tool search, **When** the agent loop builds the tools array, **Then** `tool_search_tool_bm25` is NOT included (graceful fallback)
**Given** tool_search_tool_bm25 is included, **When** Claude receives `tool_search_tool_result` blocks, **Then** the agent loop handles them correctly (no execution needed - API handles)

technical-notes.note:
The fix adds `tool_search_tool_bm25` to the tools array when: 1. Tool search is enabled (`config.toolSearch.enabled`) 2. Model supports tool search (`supportsToolSearch(model)`) 3. Deferred tools exist (`deferredToolCount > 0`)
**Code Location:** `src/agent/loop.ts` (lines 709-731)

Run the diagnostic script to verify tool search configuration: ```bash pnpm exec tsx scripts/diagnose-tool-search.ts ``` Expected output when properly configured: `tool_search_tool_bm25 WILL be included`

relevant-sections.section:
Tool Search reduces token usage when 100s of MCP tools available by lazy-loading tools on demand.
- Beta header required: `advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20` (already in allBetas) - Configure MCP tools with `defer_loading: true` for Claude to discover on demand - Model requirements: Sonnet 4.5+ or Opus 4.5+ (older models do not support tool search) - Observability: Track token savings in Langfuse: `tool_search.tokens_saved`

All beta headers consolidated in `config.anthropic.allBetas`: - context-management-2025-06-27 (Memory tool) - advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20 (PTC + Tool Search) - code-execution-2025-08-25 (Skills execution) - skills-2025-10-02 (Skills API CRUD) - files-api-2025-04-14 (File downloads)
**Rule:** Always use `config.anthropic.allBetas` in `messages.create()`. Never construct beta arrays inline.
